items.title: 3 US Broker Stocks Where Higher Rates Could Lift Interest Income
items.summary: Interest rates are rising again, inflation is still sticky, and suddenly the sleepy corner of brokerage cash and margin lending looks anything but boring. When the Fed pushes the benchmark rate to a range of 3.75% to 4%, every idle dollar in a brokerage account and every margin loan starts to matter more to investors and to the brokers themselves. items.title: WEX, Raymond James, Sallie Mae, Voya Financial, and Charles Schwab Shares Plummet, What You Need To Know
items.summary: A number of stocks fell in the afternoon session after investors kept bidding the group lower after last week’s Federal Reserve hike. On September 16, the Fed raised the federal funds target range by 25 basis points to 3.75%–4.00%, its first increase since 2023, according to the Federal Reserve’s FOMC statement.
